title: The same 'call it a draw between them' will check between Brother Osk and Vell also failed (rolled 8 vs DC11 with will+2) and stayed unresolved through the ending ('Osk and Vell never settled it') — the second of only two companion quarrels in the run, and both ended unmediated for the same reason.
where: Fenmarch / The Drowned Nave, Brother Osk vs Vell quarrel over the drowned congregation
